metadata.title: Manga Gallery
metadata.subtitle: A curated exhibition of official illustrations, promotional artwork, bonus art, and cover art from the Adachi to Shimamura manga series.

Mani.bio: Illustrator of the 2016 Adachi to Shimamura manga adaptation.

Yuzuhara Moke.bio: Illustrator of the 2019 Adachi to Shimamura manga reboot. Also known as Moke.

Shizue Kaneko.bio: Illustrator and character designer for the Adachi to Shimamura anime adaptation.

Raemz.bio: Illustrator for the Adachi to Shimamura light novel series from Volume 10 onward. Also contributed promotional and event artwork.

Japanese Manga Cover.description: Cover illustrations for the Japanese edition of the Adachi to Shimamura manga adaptation, including the 2016 series by Mani and the 2019 series by Moke, all published by Kadokawa.

Official Art.description: Official illustrations, promotional artwork, and character art from the Adachi to Shimamura series, including magazine features and Blu-ray covers.

Event Art.description: Special illustrations created for events, anniversaries, and promotional campaigns related to the Adachi to Shimamura series.

Bonus Art.description: Exclusive store bonus illustrations and extra artwork included with manga volume purchases, featuring additional scenes and character moments.
